heroDescription:
Welcome to our cozy studio, located in a modern complex on the Bulgarian Black Sea coast - the ideal place for a peaceful and unforgettable vacation.

The studio has an area of ​​40 sq.m. and is suitable for up to {{maxGuests}} guests. It has a comfortable bedroom (160×200 cm), a sofa bed, a fully equipped kitchenette, air conditioning, Wi-Fi, TV, washing machine and a spacious terrace for morning coffee or evening relaxation.

The complex offers a beautiful pool, restaurant, children's playground, 24-hour security and well-maintained green areas, which create a peaceful and pleasant atmosphere. The beach and all necessary amenities are within easy reach, which makes the studio an excellent choice for both families and couples. Treat yourself to comfort, peace and sea emotions - we are waiting for you!
